responsibility: Defines the custom Pygments lexers used by GNAT Sphinx documentation to safely syntax-highlight Ada sources, tagged Ada snippets, and GNAT project files. It builds the RegexLexer token tables for Ada lexical elements such as comments, literals, reserved words, declarations, attributes, operators, and optional project-file keywords, and exposes the AdaLexer, TaggedAdaLexer, and GNATProjectLexer classes that Sphinx registers to colorize .adb/.ads/.ada and .gpr inputs.
